custodian_id: Codex implementation task acting exclusively as exposed source custodian; not the future predictor
input_review: Inputs contain geometry, operating conditions, facility methods, all station locations and explicit unknowns. No coefficient values, performance conclusions, published CFD curves or successful modeling choices included.
license_basis: NASA NTRS metadata determinationType=GOV_PUBLIC_USE_PERMITTED and containsThirdPartyMaterial=false. The reveal will contain attributed numerical observations, not a redistributed scan of the paper.
predictor_requirement: A fresh inference context with only reviewed input and approved tools; no source PDF, reference CSV, metadata bearing answers, seal key, browsing, RAG or inherited conversation
reviewer_independence: One exposed custodian plus source-image and numerical consistency checks; not dual independent human review.
scientific_criteria: Not frozen. Input sealing does not authorize solving or endorse any numerical model.
selection_blindness: Source selection and curation were NOT blind. Only the future predictor's runtime reference access is intended to be withheld.
selection_rule: One complete localized fixed-transition series near Reynolds number six million: Table XIII first subtable, M=0.15, R=5.95e6, No. 180 grit. All 18 rows and both near-zero operating points retained. No row selected or removed for outcome quality.
transcription_review: 36 CL/CD observations manually transcribed and checked against the rendered PDF page; textual OCR sign errors were not accepted blindly. Printed lift/drag ratios used only inside custody as a secondary transcription consistency check.
